title: Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Chrome Edition)
description: The Ather Energy Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Chrome Edition) is crafted for effortless city navigation and exceptional fuel economy, positioned in the Urban Electric Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 450cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
